question: Which of the following novels is NOT written by Chetan Bhagat?

options.text: Who Will Cry When You Die?

solution:
The correct answer is __**Who Will Cry When You Die?**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Who Will Cry When You Die?** is a book written by **Robin Sharma**, not Chetan Bhagat.
 
• Robin Sharma is a Canadian writer, best known for his book series **"The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari"**.
 
• Chetan Bhagat is a famous Indian author known for his novels like **"Five Point Someone," "2 States," and "Half Girlfriend"**.
 
• The other options such as **The Girl in Room 105, One Arranged Murder,** and **400 Days** are indeed written by Chetan Bhagat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The Girl in Room 105**

 
 
• It is a novel written by Chetan Bhagat and was released in 2018.
 
• The book is a romantic thriller about a young man named Keshav who gets involved in solving the mystery of his ex-girlfriend's death.
 
 
 
• **One Arranged Murder**
 
 
• Released in 2020, this novel by Chetan Bhagat is a murder mystery with a backdrop of an arranged marriage.
 
• It follows the story of Keshav and Saurabh, who try to solve the murder of Saurabh's fiancée.
 
 
 
• **400 Days**
 
 
• This novel by Chetan Bhagat was published in 2021.
 
• The book is a mystery about a missing girl and the efforts to find her.
 
 
 
• **Who Will Cry When You Die?**
 
 
• Written by Robin Sharma, it is part of the series "The Monk Who Sold His Ferrari."
 
• The book offers life lessons and tips for leading a meaningful life.
